facts.frame: PARDUS Spark Tourist HS-EPS+ carbon frame with HS-HPT carbon fork

facts.frame_construction: EPS+ one-piece molded carbon chassis with externally serviceable BSA bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: PARDUS describes load and impact performance for its HS carbon and a tighter, smoother EPS+ lay-up; this is a qualitative manufacturer construction claim, not a measured stiffness result

source_note: The exact 2026 Spark Tourist Magene PES 1×12 build remains identifiable at CNY 5,499, but no complete-bike weight or weighing basis was found after 50 areas. Spark AL and Spark Sport weight reports are different products.
